headline: Thomas Scott submits quarterly depository participant certificate
hook: Routine compliance filing for Thomas Scott
summary: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has submitted its compliance certificate under regulation 74(5) of SEBI regulations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The filing confirms the dematerialisation and rematerialisation of securities for the period. This is a routine regulatory requirement for listed companies. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock see no direct financial impact from this procedural disclosure.
why_it_matters: No financial impact, purely procedural compliance filing

headline: Thomas Scott submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Procedural voting results filed at exchange
summary: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing completes the routine post-AGM compliance requirements for the company. This is a standard corporate filing with no immediate financial impact on the company's operations. Retail shareholders can review the passed resolutions on the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on your portfolio.
